questions.question:
Choose the connector (or pair of connectors) that best fills the blank(s).

The roads were flooded; ______, the schools remained closed.

Which option is correct?
questions.explanation: The closing of the schools is the result of the flooding, so a result connector fits.

questions.question:
Choose the connector (or pair of connectors) that best fills the blank(s).

She was tired; ______, she finished the report.

Which option is correct?
questions.explanation: Finishing the report goes against what tiredness would suggest, so a contrast connector fits.

questions.question:
Choose the connector (or pair of connectors) that best fills the blank(s).

______ it was raining, the match went ahead.

Which option is correct?
questions.explanation: The match going ahead contrasts with the rain, so a concession connector fits.

questions.question:
Choose the connector (or pair of connectors) that best fills the blank(s).

You will not pass ______ you study seriously.

Which option is correct?
questions.explanation: The meaning is "if you do not study seriously you will not pass", which is expressed by unless.

questions.question:
Choose the connector (or pair of connectors) that best fills the blank(s).

He missed the bus ______ he woke up late.

Which option is correct?
questions.explanation: Waking up late is the reason he missed the bus.

questions.question:
Choose the connector (or pair of connectors) that best fills the blank(s).

The shop sells books; ______, it offers stationery.

Which option is correct?
questions.explanation: The second idea adds to the first, so an addition connector fits.

questions.question:
Choose the connector (or pair of connectors) that best fills the blank(s).

Ravi is outgoing, ______ his brother is shy.

Which option is correct?
questions.explanation: The two ideas are set against each other, so a contrast conjunction fits.

questions.question:
Choose the connector (or pair of connectors) that best fills the blank(s).

Take an umbrella; ______, you may get wet.

Which option is correct?
questions.explanation: "Otherwise" means "if you do not", which explains the consequence of not taking an umbrella.

questions.question:
Choose the connector (or pair of connectors) that best fills the blank(s).

______ his illness, he attended the meeting.

Which option is correct?
questions.explanation: Attending the meeting contrasts with being ill, and a noun phrase follows, so despite fits.

questions.question:
Choose the connector (or pair of connectors) that best fills the blank(s).

The company will hire more staff ______ sales continue to grow.

Which option is correct?
questions.explanation: Hiring depends on sales growing, which is a condition.

questions.question:
Choose the connector (or pair of connectors) that best fills the blank(s).

She works hard ______ she may achieve her goals.

Which option is correct?
questions.explanation: Working hard is the means to an end, which "so that" expresses.

questions.question:
Choose the connector (or pair of connectors) that best fills the blank(s).

The project was delayed ______ a shortage of materials.

Which option is correct?
questions.explanation: A noun phrase (a shortage of materials) gives the reason for the delay.

questions.question:
Choose the connector (or pair of connectors) that best fills the blank(s).

The first plan was costly; the second, ______, was cheap and effective.

Which option is correct?
questions.explanation: The second plan is contrasted with the first.

questions.question:
Choose the connector (or pair of connectors) that best fills the blank(s).

He had not studied at all; ______, he failed the test.

Which option is correct?
questions.explanation: Failing is the consequence of not studying.

questions.question:
Choose the connector (or pair of connectors) that best fills the blank(s).

______ the team played well, they lost the match; ______, they did not lose heart.

Which option is correct?
questions.explanation: Playing well and losing contrast (although); not losing heart despite the loss is another contrast (nevertheless).

questions.question:
Choose the connector (or pair of connectors) that best fills the blank(s).

The price was low; ______, the quality was poor. ______, customers bought it in large numbers.

Which option is correct?
questions.explanation: Low price against poor quality is a contrast (however); buying in large numbers despite poor quality is another contrast (nevertheless).

questions.question:
Choose the connector (or pair of connectors) that best fills the blank(s).

He is not only intelligent ______ also hardworking.

Which option is correct?
questions.explanation: "Not only… but also" is a fixed pair.

questions.question:
Choose the connector (or pair of connectors) that best fills the blank(s).

Neither the manager ______ the clerks knew about the change.

Which option is correct?
questions.explanation: "Neither… nor" is a fixed pair.

questions.question:
Choose the connector (or pair of connectors) that best fills the blank(s).

______ you apologise, she will not speak to you.

Which option is correct?
questions.explanation: The meaning is "if you do not apologise, she will not speak to you".

questions.question:
Choose the connector (or pair of connectors) that best fills the blank(s).

Hardly had we reached home ______ it started to rain.

Which option is correct?
questions.explanation: "Hardly… when" is the fixed correlative pair; "no sooner… than" is the other.
